plan.design: Start from current main with one lock-only first commit. Copy codec and its two tests byte-for-byte from exact PR856 SHA with provenance. Independent module validates candidate using unchanged codec, then walks active data, schema row views and arrival ordinals in JSON enumeration order, emitting bounded chunks directly to an independent reference comparison with first-difference positions. No full legacy hydrate, complete output concatenate or cloned arrivals in streaming comparator. Existing validator hash stringify allocations remain in measurements. Reference research file is external known-SHA input, not reconstructed from candidate. Small cases compare directly with JSON.stringify. Large cases compare against original file content sequentially; game and sidecar scope explicit. No production imports from research. Full-input raw compact original is the normal reference, including all sidecars. A separate game-only reference may be prepared once from original input, with its stringify/preparation cost disclosed separately. Game digest is checked in full-input mode too. Strings, including keys, are escaped incrementally; no giant scalar JSON.stringify then slice. Numeric scalar representation uses native JSON.stringify. Emitted chunks at most16384 UTF-16 units (at most64KiB UTF-8); reference reads at most64KiB. No array-wide Object.keys/map or whole output join; auxiliary state depends on depth, object-key/schema width, not a whole-process O(1) claim. Independent anchors remain outside candidate, exact comparison requires both EOF, reports first difference in UTF-16 units and logical path, and candidate remains unchanged throughout synchronous emission/consumption. Reference raw/full-input SHA is ee2849503b2b9113b388a2c8049a1c8b650afc64821719ad7c42703fa9f14cf4, 11873989 bytes, including all six non-game top-level fields: userPaused, elapsed, caskSlots, recentLedger, historyRecord, recallRecord. Verify its SHA before comparison; optional game reference is native JSON.stringify of that verified original, not of candidate. Report its preparation timing and peak separately. Existing validator full body/candidate strings, ID Map and arrival-position array remain measured. MaxRSS is process-lifetime, not phase-isolated.
